description: St. Niklaus is the valley municipality below Zermatt, and the parish church consecrated in 1965 stands beside the older onion-domed tower at the entrance to the old village. The tower’s baroque crown was completed in 1726. The Findeln chapel above Zermatt is a different place and is already published. No giant figure of the saint is standing in late September. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 16°C, with a breeze, dry air, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
